    set_repo [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_factory_config" label="Resolve repository root" output_key="repo" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_factory_root="${factory_root}" action_fallback="." action_key="work_dir" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]

    intake_gate -> spawn_brainstorm [condition="has_issue=true"]
    preflight_gate -> intake_gate [condition="context_contract_preflight_status!=context_contract_preflight_ok"]
    preflight_gate -> set_domain_result [condition="context_contract_preflight_status=context_contract_preflight_ok"]
    spawn_brainstorm -> set_domain_result
